An independent read-only probe swept prose + code with multiple spellings (yaw_rate / yawrate / yaw R² / yaw-rate / cross_yaw / aux_yaw) across Project Steering, Paper, all four hub areas, stack, taniteval, Ressources and repo root.
confirmed_absences: PROJECT_STATE.md — no comma yaw metric (probed at 4 spellings)
README.md / CLAUDE.md / DECISIONS.md — no yaw hits at all
taniteval/ — no hard-coded comma yaw metric (only baseline names + comfort bounds)
MODEL_REGISTRY.md contained NO 0.105 / 0.811 / 0.841 / 0.679 before this pass — its only comma yaw number was the stale 'yaw R² 0.000'. That was IDM_V3 escalation #2, now actioned.
Paper/ contained NO IDM-v3 comma yaw number — only the legacy 'yaw ≈ 0'.
